task_completion.description: Agent opens the floor plan image and the security requirements text file to begin the design process.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing lab_floorplan.png and security_requirements.txt open on the desktop or in an image viewer/text editor.

task_completion.description: Agent opens draw.io (or a similar diagramming tool) and imports the lab floor plan as the background layer.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The draw.io interface showing the lab floor plan image placed on the canvas.

task_completion.description: Agent places the required security icons (Cameras, Card Readers, Door Contacts, Motion Sensors, and Control Panel) onto the floor plan.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Icons or labels representing at least 8 security devices distributed across the floor plan rooms/zones.

task_completion.description: Agent draws connection lines (cabling) from each security device to the Security Control Panel located in the IT Closet.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Visible lines or 'wires' in the diagram connecting the peripheral devices to a central 'Control Panel' icon in the IT Closet area.

task_completion.description: Agent saves the design as a .drawio file and exports it as a PDF to the specified directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The file manager showing security_design.drawio and security_design.pdf in the ~/Diagrams/ folder, or the export dialog/success message in the application.

integrity.description: The agent used the graphical user interface of a diagramming tool rather than generating the file via script.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the mouse cursor interacting with draw.io menus, dragging shapes, or drawing lines.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply move a pre-existing file but actively constructed the overlay.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots showing the progressive addition of icons and connection lines over the floor plan.

integrity.description: The agent correctly identified the IT Closet for the Control Panel as per requirements.
integrity.visual_evidence: The 'Control Panel' icon is specifically placed within the room labeled 'IT Closet' on the floor plan.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The floor plan is located at ~/Desktop/lab_floorplan.png and requirements at ~/Desktop/security_requirements.txt. The final design must be saved to ~/Diagrams/security_design.drawio and exported to ~/Diagrams/security_design.pdf. Although the metadata suggests 8 devices, the actual requirements file specifies a total of 12 devices (1 Control Panel, 3 Card Readers, 4 Door Contacts, 2 Motion Sensors, and 2 Cameras). All 11 peripheral devices must have visible connection lines to the Control Panel in the IT Closet.
